statements.statement: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and lightheadedness
There is concern for an underlying cardiac arrhythmia
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack
The patient has a personal history of cerebral infarction
The service is to correlate symptomatic episodes with potential rhythm disturbances
The denial reason code is PR-204
The denial is based on the service not being covered under the patient's current benefit plan
